name: Protognathosaurus
isnote: Known only from a lower jaw fragment; PBDB places it in Cetiosauridae, which has no atlas entry.
sum: Protognathosaurus is a sauropod from the Middle Jurassic Lower Shaximiao Formation of Sichuan, China, known from one lower jaw fragment.
wsnote: Known from a jaw fragment; no size figure.
holotype: CV 00732 (ChM V732), the front left dentary, found in beds of Bathonian-Callovian age.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Olshevsky 1991

sources.text: Kataev, Boris; Wrase, David 2016. A new species of the genus Pseudognathaphanus from Nepal, with a short review of the Oriental species (Coleoptera, Carabidae, Harpalini). Entomologische Blätter und Coleoptera 112: 223–236.
